pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries or pyramiding within 60 seconds of a primary fill or inside high-volatility micro-ranges to prevent compounding losses into whipsaws.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order placement allowed during high-impact spread expansion intervals; require verified order-book imbalance and ATR-normalized volatility confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure trailing profits via SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST once unrealized gain touches +$12.00 to prevent floating profits from evaporating.
